rationale: A single, well-structured reply that lands on the ground-truth direction (door interlock/latch alignment most likely, control board possible) and gives exactly the sensible safe first steps: clean latch hooks, check door closure/sag and cabinet fit, note the pattern. Safety handling is strong (no opening casing, HV capacitor warning, interlock tampering risk, clear stop-use conditions) and escalation to Bosch/engineer is correct with sensible warranty hedging since age wasn't asked. The only soft spots are the 'almost certainly' framing, which is a touch stronger than the evidence warrants, and the absence of any clarifying questions (age, door-closing pattern) before concluding, though the hedged advice compensates.
